smart.warningGeneral: This tool is for general awareness only and is not a medical diagnosis.

underweight_mild.smart_message: Your body needs better energy support, but this is still manageable.
underweight_mild.body_analysis: This is often related to irregular meals or low muscle mass.
underweight_mild.action_plan_3: Do not stay over 4 hours without food.
underweight_mild.nutrition_strategy: Include protein, carbs, and healthy fats in each meal.
underweight_mild.behavior_trigger: If you forget meals, anchor them to fixed daily times.
underweight_mild.quick_start: Add one fixed meal daily for 7 days.

underweight_severe.smart_message: Your body shows a real energy deficit that can affect immunity and daily energy.
underweight_severe.body_analysis: Calorie intake is likely low, with possible low muscle mass.
underweight_severe.behavior_trigger: If you get full quickly, use smaller frequent portions.

normal.smart_message: Your status is good. The challenge is consistency, not reaching.
normal.body_analysis: Your energy intake and expenditure are generally balanced.
normal.nutrition_strategy: Balanced variety with less random eating.
normal.behavior_trigger: If eating out increases, track frequency first.
normal.quick_start: Keep the same routine for one week.

overweight_low.smart_message: This is the best stage for early intervention.
overweight_low.body_analysis: A small daily calorie surplus is likely accumulating.
overweight_low.nutrition_strategy: Lower sugar and improve meal quality.
overweight_low.behavior_trigger: Sugary drinks are often the main cause.

overweight_high.smart_message: Your body is consistently storing more energy than it needs.
overweight_high.body_analysis: There is a clear daily calorie surplus.
overweight_high.nutrition_strategy: Increase fiber and reduce refined carbs.
overweight_high.behavior_trigger: If you eat without hunger, the issue is behavioral too.

obesity_1_low.smart_message: Weight has started affecting body performance, but change is very possible.
obesity_1_low.body_analysis: Energy storage is ongoing and burn is lower than intake.
obesity_1_low.nutrition_strategy: Protein + fiber with lower high-calorie foods.
obesity_1_low.behavior_trigger: Fast eating can increase intake without awareness.
obesity_1_low.quick_start: Make each meal last at least 10 minutes.

obesity_1_high.smart_message: Structured action now helps prevent progression.
obesity_1_high.body_analysis: There is a persistent surplus with weak portion control.
obesity_1_high.nutrition_strategy: Strict meal structure with lower-calorie density.
obesity_1_high.behavior_trigger: When stress drives eating, address stress first.
obesity_1_high.quick_start: Log everything you eat for 3 days.

obesity_2.smart_message: Your body is under clear pressure and needs a structured plan.
obesity_2.body_analysis: There is a clear energy balance disruption.
obesity_2.nutrition_strategy: Calorie reduction with strict meal organization.
obesity_2.behavior_trigger: If stress is driving food choices, treat the root trigger.

obesity_3.smart_message: This needs serious intervention, and every small improvement matters.
obesity_3.body_analysis: A large and ongoing calorie surplus is present.
obesity_3.behavior_trigger: Start by regular meal timing before cutting portions.

bmr.smart_interpretation: This number is the minimum energy your body needs to stay alive.
bmr.energy_balance_analysis: Weight changes come from the gap between your intake and your actual energy needs.
bmr.hidden_cause_overweight: The common cause is not one meal, but a small daily surplus that accumulates.
bmr.hidden_cause_underweight: The issue is often irregular nutrition, not appetite alone.
bmr.hidden_cause_neutral: Weight stability depends on keeping intake and expenditure balanced.

goal_strategy.maintain: Keep balance between what you eat and what your body uses.
goal_strategy.lose: Create a small, sustainable calorie deficit.
goal_strategy.gain: Increase calories gradually while supporting muscle mass.

behavior_trigger.lose: The biggest failure point is consistency, not diet perfection.
behavior_trigger.maintain: Consistency with daily habits matters more than perfect days.
behavior_trigger.gain: Healthy gain needs structure, not random eating.

quick_action.maintain: Keep your current eating pattern stable.

healthToolsPage.heroDesc: Use our interactive health tools to track your fitness and well-being. Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) and Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) to gain insights into your overall health.
healthToolsPage.whatIsBmiP1: Body Mass Index (BMI) is a simple and widely used method to assess your weight in relation to your height. It helps categorize your body weight into one of several categories: underweight, normal weight, overweight, and obesity. While it doesn't directly measure body fat, it serves as an excellent starting point for understanding your overall health status.
healthToolsPage.whatIsBmiP2: You can input your weight in kilograms and your height in centimeters into the tool. The calculator will do the math for you and display your BMI result along with its corresponding category. For example, if your BMI falls within the range of 18.5 to 24.9, you are considered to have a healthy weight.
healthToolsPage.whatIsBmrP1: Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) is the number of calories your body requires to perform essential life-sustaining functions, such as breathing, circulation, and cell production, while at rest. It doesn’t include the energy spent on physical activities, but instead, it’s the baseline amount of energy your body needs just to keep you alive and functioning.
healthToolsPage.whatIsBmrP2: BMR is calculated based on several factors, including your weight, height, age, and gender. It uses a formula that provides an estimate of the minimum number of calories your body burns while at rest throughout the day.
healthToolsPage.bmiCardSubtitle: Calculate your Body Mass Index and understand your weight category
healthToolsPage.bmrCardSubtitle: Calculate your Basal Metabolic Rate — estimate your body's daily calorie burn.
healthToolsPage.bmrDisclaimer: Note: This calculator provides an estimate based on common formulas and should not replace professional medical advice. Consult a healthcare provider for personalized guidance.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmiTitle: Benefits of Using the BMI Calculator
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmiSubtitle: Understanding your BMI empowers you to make informed decisions about your health.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmi1Desc: Get an immediate overview of your current health status and identify potential areas for improvement.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmi2Desc: Our interactive tool provides a seamless user experience, making it effortless to calculate your weight and height.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmi3Desc: Understand your weight status by categorizing it into underweight, normal, overweight, and obese.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmi4Desc: Monitor changes over time and gain insights into your health journey, helping you stay motivated toward your wellness goals.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmi5Desc: Early detection of weight-related health risks, allowing you to take proactive steps towards a healthier lifestyle.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmi6Desc: Use your BMI as a baseline to set realistic health goals and work towards achieving your ideal weight.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmrTitle: Benefits of Using the BMR Calculator
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmrSubtitle: Knowing your BMR is the first step toward optimizing your nutrition and fitness.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmr1Desc: Understand how many calories your body needs at rest to maintain vital functions and plan your nutrition accordingly.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmr2Desc: Gain insight into your metabolism based on your age, gender, weight, and height for a more accurate picture.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmr3Desc: Use your BMR to plan caloric intake and exercise routines that align with your weight and health goals.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmr4Desc: Monitor your BMR over time to make informed adjustments to diet and lifestyle for better health outcomes.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmr5Desc: Track whether you're in a calorie deficit or surplus to support healthy weight loss or gain.
healthToolsPage.benefitsBmr6Desc: BMR is a key component of your Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE), helping you plan total calorie needs.

about.heroDesc: Your journey toward recovery begins here… where pain turns into hope, and treatment becomes a fully integrated human experience that brings together science, precision, and care.
about.heroImageAlt: Rehabilitation session with therapist and patient
about.whoWeAreText: Al Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center is dedicated to providing exceptional rehabilitation care that goes beyond just treatment. Our focus is on restoring a patient's movement, confidence, and quality of life through personalized and evidence-based therapy. As a leading center in physical therapy and medical rehabilitation, we operate with the highest medical standards, using the latest global treatment protocols. We stand out as the founders of an international research network that spans over 100 centers in 19 countries, allowing us to continuously update our treatment plans based on the most current scientific advancements. We offer flexible treatment options tailored to each patient's needs, whether at our center or at home, with a dedicated transportation service to ensure continuous care. Our sessions are personalized and focused on individual treatment plans rather than fixed time durations, making the patient experience more effective and impactful. At Al Motahadi, we prioritize the human aspect of rehabilitation, placing the patient's comfort and needs at the core of every step of their therapeutic journey.
about.ourVisionText: To be a leading and reference center in the Sultanate of Oman and the region in the field of medical rehabilitation and physical therapy, by delivering therapeutic and research services of global quality and transforming the rehabilitation journey into a true story of life restoration.
about.ourMissionText: To provide comprehensive medical rehabilitation services based on advanced scientific treatment protocols, while respecting privacy, personalizing treatment for each patient, and strengthening mutual trust between the patient and the medical team.
about.humanFirstDesc: We place the patient at the center of every decision and step.
about.scientificExcellenceDesc: We innovate and lead through the latest global research-based protocols.
about.transparencyTrustDesc: We build our relationship with patients and the community on honesty and clarity.
about.professionalConfidentialityDesc: We adhere to the highest standards of patient data protection and privacy.
about.innovationDesc: We integrate science, experience, and technology to make a real difference.
about.responsibilityDesc: Serving the community is a core and firmly rooted part of our identity.
about.ourStoryHeading: Al Motahadi Center: From Idea to Opening
about.ourStoryText: The concept of Al Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center originated from a visionary goal to transform the rehabilitation sector in Oman by introducing a model that blends scientific excellence, human compassion, and community service. The center aimed to bring a fundamental change to the delivery of rehabilitation services, keeping pace with global advancements and focusing on the human aspect of therapy. The trial phase of the center began on September 1, 2024, with the training of medical and administrative teams, development of patient reception systems, and establishment of a culture of professional ethics. The official opening occurred on February 15, 2025, under the patronage of Her Highness Sayyida Hajija bint Jaifer Al Said, attended by dignitaries and health professionals. Since its opening, Al Motahadi has become a leading institution in medical rehabilitation in Oman, committed to maintaining high-quality standards and continuously evolving its treatment protocols through research and evaluation.
about.ourStoryImageAlt: Al Motahadi Center official opening ceremony — ribbon-cutting with dignitaries
about.founderDesc1: Behind the establishment of Al Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center stands Dr. Mohammed Reda bin Naji Al-Yazidi, a specialist in physical therapy and medical rehabilitation, and a pioneer in developing modern therapeutic models. He did not only establish the center, but also founded the international research network that is today considered one of the most prominent sources of advanced treatment protocols adopted by the center.
about.founderDesc2: His personal experience as a person with a disability shaped within him a deep human sensitivity and a unique understanding of patient needs; for him, care is not a service... but a human commitment.
about.founderDesc3: His journey combines clinical practice, scientific research, and academic influence, making Al Motahadi Center a landmark that embodies excellence in both knowledge and spirit.
about.founderImageAlt: Dr. Mohammed Reda bin Naji Al-Yazidi — Founder, Al Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center
about.medicalTeamDesc1: Al Motahadi Center includes an elite group of highly experienced specialists in physical therapy and rehabilitation, working according to the MDT (Multidisciplinary Team) model, which enables the development of a comprehensive and integrated treatment plan tailored to each case and regularly reviewed based on actual progress indicators.
about.medicalTeamDesc2: Our team's role is not limited to delivering treatment alone; they actively participate in scientific research conducted by the international research network, making them contributors to the creation of medical knowledge—not merely implementers of it.
about.medicalTeamDesc3: They are not just a therapeutic team... but partners in creating impact.
about.medicalTeamImageAlt: Al Motahadi medical team — healthcare professionals
about.socialResponsibilityText1: At Al Motahadi Center, we believe that our mission goes beyond treatment to include serving the community. Through the Ehata program, directed toward those most in need of rehabilitation services, we contribute to supporting low-income patients, the elderly, women and persons with disabilities through the Hope, Charity, Care, and Step packages.
about.socialResponsibilityText2: We also offer special discounts for retirees and employees of the Royal Oman Police, and organize educational workshops and awareness courses in partnership with government and private institutions to promote rehabilitation culture and quality of life.

doctorProfile.drMohammedBio:
Dr. Mohamed Ridha Ben Naji Elyazidi is an experienced Physical Therapist specializing in musculoskeletal rehabilitation. With over 10 years of experience, Dr. Elyazidi is dedicated to restoring patient mobility and improving their quality of life through personalized rehabilitation treatments.

Dr. Elyazidi believes in a holistic approach to rehabilitation, focusing not only on treating the physical injury but also on the patient's mental and emotional well-being. He develops individualized treatment plans that address the root cause of each condition, ensuring comprehensive recovery and lasting results.
doctorProfile.drSafaaBio:
Dr. Safaa Mohammed Mahrez is a highly skilled Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Specialist with over 8 years of experience in musculoskeletal rehabilitation. Dr. Mahrez is dedicated to helping patients achieve optimal recovery through individualized care plans that address both physical and emotional well-being.

Dr. Mahrez believes in a comprehensive and patient-centered approach to rehabilitation. By focusing on both injury recovery and overall health, Dr. Mahrez ensures each treatment plan is designed to suit the unique needs and goals of every patient. Her holistic approach combines physical therapy with psychological support to promote healing from within.
doctorProfile.drSirineBio:
Dr. Sirine Al-Habib Al-Qasimi is a dedicated Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Specialist with over 7 years of experience in the field. With a passion for improving patients' physical health, Dr. Al-Qasimi helps individuals recover from injuries and manage chronic conditions to lead a healthier life.

Dr. Al-Qasimi adopts a patient-first approach, ensuring each rehabilitation program is personalized to address the specific needs and goals of the individual. By using evidence-based techniques, she focuses on helping patients regain independence, improve mobility, and enhance overall well-being. Her philosophy is rooted in providing care that nurtures both the body and mind for a holistic recovery.

blog.post1Body:
Starting rehabilitation soon after injury or surgery can significantly improve recovery speed and long-term results. At Al Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center we focus on early intervention as part of a personalized treatment plan.

Research shows that the first weeks after surgery or injury are critical for restoring function and preventing complications. Our team uses evidence-based protocols to guide you through each phase safely.

Whether you have had joint surgery, a sports injury, or a neurological event, beginning rehabilitation early—under expert supervision—helps you regain mobility, strength, and independence more effectively.
blog.post2Body:
Safe, effective exercises between sessions can support your recovery. Always check with your therapist before starting any new routine.

We often recommend gentle range-of-motion and strengthening exercises that you can do at home, tailored to your condition and stage of recovery. Consistency and correct form matter more than intensity.

Your therapist will show you each exercise and advise on frequency and progressions so you can stay on track between visits.
blog.post3Body:
Understanding typical recovery milestones helps you track progress and stay motivated throughout rehabilitation.

Every person’s journey is different, but there are common phases: from initial healing and pain management to restored movement, strength, and return to daily activities. Our team sets clear goals and reviews them with you regularly.

Celebrating small wins and keeping a long-term view can make a real difference in your outlook and outcomes.
blog.post4Body:
Evidence-based approaches and technology are continually improving outcomes in neurological and organic rehabilitation.

At Al Motahadi we use protocols developed through our international research network, combined with modern equipment and a multidisciplinary team. Treatment is tailored to each patient’s condition and goals.

From assessment to discharge, we focus on measurable progress and quality of life, so you and your family can see the benefits of dedicated neurological rehab.
blog.post5Body:
Staying active safely after an injury protects your recovery and helps you avoid setbacks while maintaining movement and strength.

Our therapists design programs that balance rest and gradual loading, with clear guidance on what to do and what to avoid. We also consider your work, sport, and daily activities so the plan fits your life.

With the right approach, you can keep moving forward without risking reinjury—and return to the activities you care about with confidence.
blog.post6Body:
We are pleased to share the latest updates from Al Motahadi—new services, team highlights, and ways we are improving your care.

Our center continues to invest in training, equipment, and patient experience. We listen to your feedback and adapt our offerings to better serve the community.

Thank you for trusting us with your rehabilitation journey. We look forward to supporting you in the months ahead.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.heroDesc: This Cookie Policy explains how Al Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience while respecting your privacy.
cookies.s1Intro: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience. Cookies generally do not personally identify you; they recognize your device or browser and allow the site to function properly and remember choices you have made.
cookies.s2Intro: We use the following categories of cookies:
cookies.s2Essential: Essential Cookies: Crucial for website operation, including security, session management, appointment booking, form functionality, and user preferences. These cookies enable core features and a personalized experience.
cookies.s2Performance: Performance Cookies: Collect anonymous data about how the website is used, such as page load times, content popularity, error rates, and user navigation patterns. This helps us improve site performance and usability.
cookies.s2Analytical: Analytical Cookies: Help us understand how users interact with our website—for example, visitor numbers, geographic regions, and campaign effectiveness. The data is used in aggregate to improve our content and services.
cookies.s3Intro: You have the right to manage or reject cookies. You can control cookies through your browser settings. In most browsers (such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge), you can block or delete cookies via the privacy or security settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality and your ability to use some features. For specific services such as Google Analytics, you can use the opt-out tools or links provided by those services to manage or disable their cookies.
cookies.s4Intro: Disabling or blocking cookies can negatively affect your experience on our website. You may notice reduced functionality, longer load times, and limited access to interactive features such as forms, appointment booking, or personalized content. Some parts of the site may not work as intended if essential cookies are disabled.
cookies.s5Intro: Third-party services integrated into our website may also set cookies. These can include services such as Google Analytics, social media widgets, and payment processors. These third parties have their own privacy and cookie policies, and we encourage you to review them to understand how they use cookies and data.
cookies.s6Intro: Our use of cookies complies with applicable privacy and data protection regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA (where relevant to health data), and PIPEDA where applicable. We are committed to protecting your data and being transparent about how we use cookies and similar technologies.
cookies.s7Intro: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or legal requirements. We encourage you to review this page periodically. The "Last Updated" date at the top of this policy indicates when the most recent changes were made.
